_comment: multiple-version line, MC 1.19.2 fabric. Runs the standalone in-client UI test harness (uitest/mv-1.19.2-fabric, an independent build in this repository) through the three-stage pipeline config->build->test. The harness build stages the two jars under test into the run's mods/ folder itself (production fabric jars are intermediary-named; fabric-loader's dev-mode remapper brings them into the run's namespace) and takes fabric-api as its own remapped Gradle dependency at exactly the pinned version, so jech, jei and fabric-api all carry via=dev-classpath: there is nothing for jt to stage. The row is a harness row since this move (2026-10-15): it declares no ready_when and no world, because the harness's own runner creates and pins its flat level and quits the client when the selection is done. That is also what promoted the JEI storage marker from unreachable to checked: JEI 11.x emits it while a level loads, and before this move no non-interactive way to load a level existed before 1.20 (--quickPlaySingleplayer is 1.20+), so the row could only assert startup markers; the harness's createFreshLevel reaches the marker without quick-play. daemon_java is 17 because the harness wrapper is Gradle 8.1.1, which cannot run on the machine's default JDK (JBR 25). Upstream's two fabric pins stay corrected the way the checkout corrected them: loader 0.16.14 (the pinned jei 11.30.3.1056 requires fabricloader >=0.15.11) and api 0.77.0+1.19.2 — the last fabric-api build for MC 1.19.2, the one that satisfies JEI's floor.
